1) 用 ipmitool sdr type fan 看每个风扇的转速与门限，定: 1) Run ipmitool sdr type fan to see each fan's speed and thresholds and identify the faulty one; 2) A fan reading 0 or far below its peers is almost certainly failed — schedule a replacement; 3) If every fan is running fast, intake temperature or load is too high: check room temperature, dust in the filters and any airflow obstruction; 4) Before swapping fans, run ipmitool sdr type temperature to see whether temperatures have already risen, and move workloads off if needed.
1) 用 ipmitool sdr type temperature 确认各温度: 1) Run ipmitool sdr type temperature to see the actual readings and thresholds of each temperature sensor; 2) Check that all chassis fans are spinning (ipmitool sdr type fan) and that filters and heatsinks are not clogged with dust; 3) Confirm the room air conditioning and cold aisle temperature are normal and whether other machines in the same rack are also hot; 4) Short term, reduce load on this machine or move critical workloads off to buy time for a dust-clean or fan replacement.
1) 用 ipmitool sdr type temperature 确认是哪个: 1) Run ipmitool sdr type temperature to identify which sensor is hot and what its threshold is; 2) Check the chassis fans and airflow, especially whether cabling is blocking intake around the motherboard; 3) Confirm the room air conditioning and in-rack temperature, and whether the machine is wedged into an enclosed spot; 4) Clean the dust, tidy the cabling and re-measure; if it still does not drop, contact the vendor to inspect the heatsink assembly.
1) 用 ipmitool sdr type voltage 看各电压传感器的读: 1) Run ipmitool sdr type voltage to see each voltage sensor's reading against its upper and lower thresholds and which way it deviates; 2) Check the power supply status (ipmitool sdr type 'Power Supply'); on dual-PSU machines confirm whether one feed has failed; 3) Check the power line and PDU output stability, and whether other machines in the same rack are alarming at the same time; 4) If a PSU is confirmed faulty, schedule a replacement and move critical workloads off meanwhile.
BMC 报告 CPU 供电电压已越过临界门限（lcr/ucr），供电异常可能导致: The BMC reports that CPU supply voltage has crossed a critical threshold (lcr/ucr); unstable power can cause CPU instability, random reboots or even hardware damage.
BMC 报告有风扇转速越过门限。转速过低通常意味着风扇故障或卡死，会直接导致 C: The BMC reports a fan speed crossing its threshold. Too slow usually means a failed or seized fan and will directly overheat the CPU and disks; abnormally fast means cooling pressure is already high.
主板/PCH 温度超过 90℃，主板供电与芯片组长期高温会导致不稳定与元件老化，: Motherboard/PCH temperature is above 90°C; sustained heat on board power delivery and the chipset causes instability and component ageing, and can lead to random crashes.
服务器 CPU 温度超过 90℃，已接近throttling 阈值，CPU 会降: Server CPU temperature is above 90°C, close to the throttling threshold; the CPU will down-clock and performance will drop sharply, and sustained heat can trigger a protective shutdown.
